input.query: SELECT channel, months_since_activation, sum(cohort_size) cohort_users, sum(n_active) active_users, sum(n_active)::DOUBLE/sum(cohort_size) retention FROM agg_retention_cohorts WHERE months_since_activation BETWEEN 6 AND 12 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT channel, max(months_since_activation) max_tenure, sum(avg_margin_eur) FILTER (WHERE months_since_activation <= 36) AS ltv_36m, max(cac_eur) cac FROM agg_unit_economics GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel
